fee_notes: Fee is negotiated based on population, number of potential commercial accounts, and other factors in the Development Area — no fixed formula. Typical range for new franchisees with no prior Vanguard relationship is $100,000–$350,000. Discounted fees of $10,000–$75,000 are available to existing Subfranchisors, their affiliates, or Vanguard employees. In 2025, no initial fees were charged to existing Area Franchisor affiliates. Fee is paid in full at signing unless financing is arranged. Non-refundable except as required by law or per Item 6, Footnote 5 (OnBoarding termination scenario).
raw_excerpt: If you have no prior relationship with Vanguard, the initial franchise fee for a typical Development Area would most likely fall within a range of $100,000 and $350,000. Vanguard has offered, and may in its discretion continue to offer, discounted initial franchise fees to existing Subfranchisors or their affiliates or to employees of Vanguard. Discounted initial franchise fees in these cases are expected to range between $10,000 and $75,000. In 2025, no initial fees were charged to existing Area Franchisor affiliates.
